- Candidate `exp_macro_alpha_shadow` shows promise with +19% better lockbox_min

- MDD degradation (~7% worse fold14, ~20% worse overall) likely blocked promotion

```bash

python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

Shall I proceed with execution, or do you want to review/modify the commands first?
